//: Copy to $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/manao/config.json (default ~/.config/manao/config.json), or point MANAO_CONFIG at it. Every option is optional: with no file at all the hub runs Herdr with the defaults below. Keys starting with // are comments. Never put secrets here.
//dbPath: Where the SQLite store lives: an absolute path, or one starting with ~/. MANAO_DB wins over it. Default: $XDG_DATA_HOME/manao/hub.db (~/.local/share/manao/hub.db).
//eventRetentionDays: Events older than this many days are pruned. Whole number. Default 30.
//api: The read-only HTTP API (GET /api/items, /api/events, /api/sources, /api/agenda, /api/measurements). It listens on 127.0.0.1 only; reach it from other devices with tailscale serve (see the README), never funnel. Set to false to run the hub without it.

api.//port: Port on 127.0.0.1. Whole number; 0 picks a free one. Default 7420.

//sources: Each key is one enabled Source; leave a Source out to turn it off. Leaving out "sources" entirely enables Herdr with its defaults.

herdr.//: The agents running in the Herdr app, read from herdr-core's socket. The Source is herdr:local.
herdr.//socketPath: Absolute path (or ~/...) to herdr-core's socket. Default: $XDG_STATE_HOME/herdr-core/default/default.sock (~/.local/state/...).
herdr.//intervalSeconds: Safety-net poll interval in seconds. Default 5.
herdr.//events: Subscribe to herdr-core events so changes land between polls. Default true.
herdr.//staleAfterSeconds: How long a Health report counts as recent; after that Herdr's Items are Stale. Default 3x intervalSeconds.

sources.//brainDump: Opt-in Todos from Brain-Dump's CLI. Remove this key to turn the Source off. The hub never reads the vault directly.

brainDump.//command: Bare executable on PATH, absolute path or ~/... . Default brain-dump. Under launchd, both brain-dump and its bun interpreter must be resolvable.
brainDump.//staleAfterSeconds: How long a Health report counts as recent. Default 3x intervalSeconds.

sources.//googleCalendar: Opt-in Appointments from the connected Google account (see google below), read-only. Remove this key to turn the Source off. Its Source id is google-calendar:primary.

googleCalendar.//calendars: Calendar ids of that account to read; primary is its own calendar. Others are listed in Google Calendar's settings, under Integrate calendar. Default ["primary"].
googleCalendar.//daysAhead: Fetch from the start of Today to the end of Today plus this many days. Whole number. Default 7.
googleCalendar.//staleAfterSeconds: How long a Health report counts as recent. Default 3x intervalSeconds.

sources.//googleHealth: Opt-in daily Measurements (steps, sleep, resting heart rate, active zone minutes) from the connected Google account's Google Health API (see google below), read-only. Remove this key to turn the Source off; its Measurements are kept. Its Source id is google-health:primary. Enabling it adds scopes: run manao auth google again.

googleHealth.//intervalSeconds: Refresh interval in seconds. Each refresh rewrites yesterday and Today, and catches up on days missed while the hub was off. Default 3600.
googleHealth.//backfillDays: How many days before Today a refresh reaches back at most: the first run's backfill and the longest catch-up. Whole number from 1 to 90. Default 30.
googleHealth.//staleAfterSeconds: How long a Health report counts as recent. Default 3x intervalSeconds.

sources.//paperBot: Opt-in research Picks from paper-bot's CLI (paper-bot picks --json): this week's Picks, with Health following paper-bot's Scans. Remove this key to turn the Source off. Its Source id is paper-bot:picks. The hub never writes to paper-bot or the vault.

paperBot.//command: Bare executable on PATH, absolute path or ~/... . Default paper-bot. Under launchd it must be resolvable on the LaunchAgent's PATH.
paperBot.//staleAfterSeconds: How long a Health report counts as recent. Default 3x intervalSeconds.

//google: The Google connection, required by googleCalendar and googleHealth. manao auth google asks for the scopes of every Google Source enabled here. The token manao auth google writes lives at $XDG_DATA_HOME/manao/google-token.json (~/.local/share/manao/google-token.json), mode 0600.

google.//client: The Desktop OAuth client JSON downloaded from Cloud Console: an absolute path or ~/... . Keep it outside the repo with mode 0600.
